guides.favoredWhen: Easy lane for her, late problem for you. Keep the ball on yourself, hold R for her E.

keyTips.text: Easy lane for her: concede pressure from level 1.
She stands opposite your ball: move it to both sides.
She saves E for your R: bait the dash before comboing.

tips.text: Your Q right after E is her all-in window: never Q-E predictably.
You are tankier with ball on yourself: keep it home when she looks.
The clock runs: banked leads must convert before late, hers, so stall.
She keeps E for R every fight: R only after the dash.
Early survived plus R landed: the Akali who never snowballed never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She spaces off the ball and shoves to roam after 6. Keep the ball threatening, match the shove.

keyTips.text: She stands away from your ball: move it to cut her side.
When you spend the ball she walks up: hold Q until she commits.
She holds the edge in levels 1-5 with spacing: respect her early, outscale.

tips.text: She autos for wave control: match the push, deny free harass.
She steps in while you cannot answer: keep a cooldown banked.
From 6 she one-shots the wave and plays fog and river: track her roams.
Her waveclear neutralizes: shove first, look elsewhere first.
She wins through waveclear and roams, not duels: never duel, always answer.

guides.favoredWhen: The lane favors you now with Comet plus W points. Bully early, stay ungankable.

keyTips.text: The lane flipped: Comet with W points favors you now, so press it.
She dodges everything: every sidestep denies damage, so lead her.
She rushes tier-2 boots: movement is her first item, so match it.

tips.text: Win the early: your points pressure beats hers before boots land.
Her first back is boots: the dodge war starts there, so keep Qs unpredictable.
You are very gankable: ward and hold the wave instead of overextending.
She keeps dodging mid-game: W points punish the stationary, so zone with ball.
Jungle-denied lead: the ganks she never sets up are how this lane is won.

guides.favoredWhen: He baits Q at max range and combos when Q and E are down. Hold one cooldown, punish Voltaic rushes.

keyTips.text: Your early auto and Q damage: the first levels belong to your ball.
He baits Q by stepping to max range: never throw the first Q.
He combos only when Q and E are down: always keep one banked.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: His boots first back: movement baits your Q, so vary placement.
He survives to Voltaic: punish before the spike lands.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
His bait-then-combo is the whole pattern: a Q spent on a fake means death.
Win the bait war: the Zed who never sees Q never combos.

keyTips.text: Into ranged lanes, run Comet with three early ranks in W so Q-W trades hit hard, but respect those cooldowns and track ganks while pressuring.
Into melee, harass with Q often for its low cost, and after level three hold the wave near your side so divers have less room to run you down.
Fight front to back with tanks ahead: a threatening ball and a held Shockwave constrain enemy carries, so deliver it on an engager or keep it to shield and peel your ADC.

tips.text: If mana is already low at level two against ranged opponents, stop leaning on W and wait for its second rank at level three before trading heavily again.
Build the small CS lead Orianna can take in most matchups by tying every trade to a safe last hit rather than trading for its own sake.
Treat level six as a lane tool: Shockwave adds a poke and kill threat against ranged laners who previously felt safe.
Keep farm and experience flowing while arriving for every major objective fight; never sacrifice the wave timer for a rotation with no payoff.
Push a side wave only as far as the map looks safe, tracking both junglers before extending past the river line.
Without Teleport, group and collect side waves as they reach your tower; take longer side assignments only with an easy matchup, a team lead, and vision.
Recall roughly a minute before dragon to spend gold and restore health and mana, then group with a full inventory for the setup.
Once Seraph's Embrace is built, clear nearby friendly jungle camps, and consider an enemy camp when your jungler is far away and the area is safe.
Use narrow chokes and small spaces to limit where opponents can move, keeping the ball threat over the fight while your frontline holds.
Hit the frontline by default, but switch the moment a squishy steps out of position rather than tunneling the nearest target.
Hold position against dangerous enemy tools: wait out effects such as a hook before committing, since they punish Orianna's positioning hardest.

itemization.text: Run Arcane Comet with Manaflow Band, Transcendence, and Scorch plus Legend: Haste and Cut Down; open Doran's Ring and Health Potion, with Tear and two potions as the greedy alternative.
Build Seraph's Embrace into Sorcerer's Shoes, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Cryptbloom, finishing with Zhonya's Hourglass; take Mercury's Treads into double AP and crowd control.

Adapt the last slots by threat: Morellonomicon for healing, Void Staff or Cryptbloom into magic resistance, Zhonya's against physical burst, Banshee's against dangerous spells, with Mejai's, Liandry's, Cosmic Drive, or Lich Bane for snowball, long-fight, mobility, or attack-weave games.
